description:
Look up several Intune managed devices by exact device name. Sends one `$filter=deviceName eq '<name>'` request per name through Graph $batch (20 per call) and merges the results.

TIP: Resolves a list of device names to Intune managed devices in one call. Use it instead of list-managed-devices with an OR / in() filter on deviceName, which Graph answers with an empty list or a 500. Up to 500 names; matching is case-insensitive and exact (no prefix). Pass select (e.g. deviceName,isEncrypted,complianceState,osVersion,lastSyncDateTime,userPrincipalName) to keep the response small. The result lists devices, notFound names, names matching several devices (multipleMatches) and per-name errors.

deviceNames.description: Device names to resolve (1-500). Duplicates and blanks are ignored.

select.description: Comma-separated managedDevice fields to return; deviceName is always included

name: get-managed-devices-by-names
